from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    shapes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        shapes.append((c0, shape))
    shapes.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    height = max(len(shape) for _, shape in shapes)
    output = [[] for _ in range(height)]
    for _, shape in shapes:
        width = len(shape[0])
        for r in range(height):
            output[r].extend(shape[r] if r < len(shape) else [0] * width)
    return output
'''
path=programs/'task-d3969000.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
